Enam Securities Pvt. Ltd. has informed the Exchange regarding a Public Announcement made pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 8 (1) read with Regulation 15 (c) of the SEBI (Buyback of Securities) Regulations, 1998 for the time being in force including any statutory modifications and amendments from time to time ("Buyback Regulations") and contains the disclosures as specified in Schedule II to these Buyback Regulations. Details of the Buyback Offer and Offer Price: SRF Limited ("the Company") hereby announces the buyback of its own fully paid-up equity shares of the face value of Rs. 10/- each ("Shares") from the existing owners of Shares of the Company from the open market through stock exchanges using the nationwide electronic trading facilities of the Bombay Stock Exchange ("BSE") and / or the National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE") (together "the Stock Exchanges") in accordance with the provisions of Sections 77A, 77AA, 77B and all other applicable provisions, if any, of the Companies Act, 1956 ("the Act") and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buyback of Securities) Regulations, 1998 ("the Buyback Regulations") and the relevant provisions of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company subject to approval/s as may be necessary, from time to time from statutory authorities including but not limited to Securities and Exchange Board of India, stock exchanges, Reserve Bank of India etc as required at a maximum price not exceeding Rs 160 per equity share ("Maximum Buyback Price") payable in cash, for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 700 million ("the Buyback Size"). The Buyback Size represents 9.60% of the aggregate of the Company's paid-up equity capital and eligible free reserves as on March 31st, 2008 (the date of the latest standalone audited accounts) which is within the maximum permissible limit of 10% of the paid-up equity capital and eligible free reserves. The aggregate paid up capital and free reserves of the Company as at March 31, 2008 is 7289.84 million. The Date of Opening of Buyback is June 16, 2008 & Last Date for the Buyback is April 24, 2009 (i.e. 12 months from the date of the resolution passed by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on April 25, 2008) or when the Company completes the Buyback to the extent of Rs 700 Million or such earlier date as may be decided by the Company at anytime even if the maximum limit of Buyback of Shares has not been reached (by giving appropriate notice of such earlier date, if any) whichever is applicable. A copy of the Public Announcement - Buyback of Shares shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/Corporate Announcements). For more details click here.

JM Morgan Stanley Pvt Ltd has informed the Exchange regarding the Buy Back of fully paid-up Equity Shares by SRF Limited ("SRFL"). JM Morgan Stanley Private Limited has been appointed by SRF Limited as Manager to the Buy Back of equity shares through the Open Market Route of the Stock Exchange. SRF Limited ("SRFL" or the "Company") hereby announces the Buy Back ("Buy-back") of its fully paid-up equity shares of the face value of Rs.10 each ("Equity Shares") from the existing owners of equity shares from open market through the Stock Exchanges in accordance with the provision of Sections 77A,77AA and 77B of the Companies Act, 1956 ("the Act") and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-back of Securities) Regulations, 1998 ("the Buy-back Regulations") at a price not exceeding Rs.250 per Share ("Maximum Offer Price") payable in cash, for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs.3500 lacs ("Offer Size"). The Offer Size represents 9% of the aggregate of the Company's paid-up equity capital and free reserves as on March 31, 2006 (date of last audited results) and shall not exceed 10% of the total paid-up equity capital and free reserves of the Company at any point of time during this Buy-back. The number of equity share bought back would depend upon the average price paid for the Shares bought back and the amount deployed in the Buy-back. As an illustration, at the proposed Maximum Offer Price of Rs.250 per share and for an aggregate amount Rs.3500 lacs deployed, the number of Equity Shares bought back would be 14,00,000 equity shares which would amount approximately 2.17% of the paid up equity capital as on March 31, 2006, should the average purchase price be lower than Rs.250 per share, the number of equity shares bought back would be more, assuming the deployment of an aggregate amount of Rs.3500 lacs.

Hence, there is no specific minimum or maximum number of equity shares that the company proposes to buy back. However, this is subject to a maximum of 25% of the total paid up equity capital of the Company in a financial year as per the Act. The date of opening of the Buy-Back is July 03, 2006 and the Last date for the Buy Back is June 22, 2007 (12 months from the date of the Board Resolution) or such earlier date as may be determined by the Board, even if the maximum limit of buyback has not been reached, by giving an appropriate notice for such earlier date, if any. A copy of the Public announcement shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

attchmntText: Srf Ltd. had informed the Exchange that Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) project for GHG emission reduction by thermal oxidation of HFC 23 at refrigerant gas (HCFC 22) plant was granted Host Government Approval by the Government of India in February 2005. The Company has further informed that SRF has appointed M/s DNV as the Designated Operational Entity (DOE). DNV has submitted the SRF project Design Document (PDD) to the United Nations Framework Convention for Climate Change (UNFCCC) for obtaining public inputs. SRF PDD is now available at the UNFCCC website for public inputs, the period for which it is open is from June 06, 2005 to July 05, 2005 . The project is expected to start generating Certified Emission Reduction (CER) units from early 2006.A maximum of around 3.8 million CERs (subject to validation and verification) are expected to be generated from this project every year for the project duration of the next 10 years. SRF has ordered the incineration equipment which is under shipment. The project is expected to be commissioned during September /October 2005. M/s Solvay, Germany are the technology providers as well as a Project Participant for this project.
